Split a lineage string into rank columns

Source: R/dv_adapters.R
dv_parse_lineage.Rd

Metabarcoding pipelines (QIIME 2, DADA2, mothur, SILVA, Greengenes, MIDORI, BOLD, a BLAST against GenBank) report each sequence's taxonomy as one string, such as "k__Animalia; p__Arthropoda; c__Copepoda; g__Calanus; s__finmarchicus". dv_parse_lineage() splits that string into one column per rank, so the data can be prepared with dv_prepare(taxonomy = "columns"), keeping the reference taxonomy the sequences were assigned with (NCBI, SILVA, BOLD ...), or only the deepest name can be passed on to WoRMS or GBIF.

Usage

dv_parse_lineage(
  data,
  col,
  ranks = c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species"),
  sep = ";",
  format = c("auto", "prefixed", "positional"),
  name_col = "prey_name",
  placeholders = c("", "na", "nan", "none", "null", "unassigned", "unclassified",
    "uncultured", "unidentified", "unknown", "metagenome", "environmental sample")
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame.

col

Name of the column holding the lineage string.

ranks

Ranks to create, coarse to fine (default the seven flagship ranks). For positional strings they must follow the order of the fields.

sep

Field separator (default ";").

format

"auto" (default), "prefixed" or "positional".

name_col

If not NULL (default "prey_name"), a column with the deepest identified name is added (or overwritten), ready for dv_spec(prey_name = ).

placeholders

Lower-case values treated as "not identified".

Value

data with one column per rank (and name_col).

Details

Two layouts are read:

  • prefixed - each field starts with a rank code (k__, d__, p__, c__, o__, f__, g__, s__; also k:/p: and kingdom:); fields are placed by their code, so missing ranks are allowed. d__ (domain) is ignored unless "domain" is a rank;

  • positional - plain names in rank order ("Animalia;Arthropoda; ..."); the i-th field goes to the i-th rank of ranks.

format = "auto" uses prefixed when most strings carry rank codes. For positional strings, give ranks in the order of the fields: MIDORI and NCBI lineages start with a superkingdom, not a kingdom, so use e.g. ranks = c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species") and the same ranks in dv_spec(). Placeholders such as an empty field, "NA", "unassigned", "unclassified", "uncultured", "unidentified", "unknown", "metagenome" or a species written "Genus sp." become NA, so the record is shown as unidentified at that rank. Trailing NCBI tax IDs ("Calanus_6836") and underscores ("Calanus_finmarchicus") are cleaned, and a species given as an epithet only (s__finmarchicus) is completed with its genus.

See also

dv_from_wide() to reshape a sample-by-taxon table first.

Examples

x <- data.frame(asv = c("a1", "a2", "a3"), taxonomy = c(
  paste("k__Animalia; p__Arthropoda; c__Copepoda; o__Calanoida;",
        "f__Calanidae; g__Calanus; s__finmarchicus"),
  "k__Animalia; p__Chordata; c__Actinopteri; o__; f__; g__; s__",
  "Unassigned"))
dv_parse_lineage(x, "taxonomy")
#>   asv
#> 1  a1
#> 2  a2
#> 3  a3
#>                                                                                           taxonomy
#> 1 k__Animalia; p__Arthropoda; c__Copepoda; o__Calanoida; f__Calanidae; g__Calanus; s__finmarchicus
#> 2                                     k__Animalia; p__Chordata; c__Actinopteri; o__; f__; g__; s__
#> 3                                                                                       Unassigned
#>    kingdom     phylum       class     order    family   genus
#> 1 Animalia Arthropoda    Copepoda Calanoida Calanidae Calanus
#> 2 Animalia   Chordata Actinopteri      <NA>      <NA>    <NA>
#> 3     <NA>       <NA>        <NA>      <NA>      <NA>    <NA>
#>                species            prey_name
#> 1 Calanus finmarchicus Calanus finmarchicus
#> 2                 <NA>          Actinopteri
#> 3                 <NA>                 <NA>
# plain names in rank order, as in many BLAST or BOLD outputs
y <- data.frame(lin = paste("Animalia;Arthropoda;Malacostraca;Euphausiacea",
                            "Euphausiidae;Meganyctiphanes",
                            "Meganyctiphanes norvegica", sep = ";"))
dv_parse_lineage(y, "lin")
#>                                                                                                    lin
#> 1 Animalia;Arthropoda;Malacostraca;Euphausiacea;Euphausiidae;Meganyctiphanes;Meganyctiphanes norvegica
#>    kingdom     phylum        class        order       family           genus
#> 1 Animalia Arthropoda Malacostraca Euphausiacea Euphausiidae Meganyctiphanes
#>                     species                 prey_name
#> 1 Meganyctiphanes norvegica Meganyctiphanes norvegica
